description.value: B&D Authentic Viet Cuisine is a family-run Vietnamese restaurant on Burnaby's Kingsway corridor, opened in April 2022 by owners Bella and Dat, who bring traditional Saigon-style recipes with a contemporary presentation. The menu goes well beyond pho, featuring slow-simmered crab soup, tapioca dumplings, and specialty skewers, with numerous items clearly labelled vegan and gluten-free. Since opening it has attracted coverage from Daily Hive, Burnaby Beacon, and participation in local food festivals, making it a recognized dining destination in the area.
